translations.web: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
translations.bsb: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
translations.kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
